edits.before: - Swain Demonic Ascension: matchup-defining — His drain mode — disengage and reset the fight when it starts. It governs your forward steps. - E Nevermove spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Swain Demonic Ascension: matchup-defining — a 120s cooldown, his drain mode; disengage and reset the fight when it starts. - E Nevermove is 12s at rank 1 — spent on poke it is a death you scheduled. - Hold your R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: E his step-up, passive-pull the root for the chunk + heal, Q the retreat — every landed root is a won trade with a health refund attached.
edits.after: Both demons share the 120s R — let him flip his first on a wave, step out of the 650-range drain, and ascend for the fight after.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 like the demon is already online — Swain without R is a slow mage with a dream and a root on cooldown.
edits.after: His R drains your minions too — brawling inside a dying wave hands the demon extra heal targets; drag him out of the crowd.
